'''Starlight Towers''' was an apartment complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was located in the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]]. It was also home to a decommissioned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] law enforcement facility that the Justicars took control of and renamed [[Justicars' Tower]].
